summary: Sensys Gatso Group AB (publ), together with its subsidiaries, provides automated traffic enforcement solutions in Sweden and internationally. It operates in two segments, System Sales and Managed Services. The company offers fixed spot, portable, moving in-vehicle, and smart in-tunnel speed enforcement, as well as section control and dual speed warning and enforcement system; red light enforcement; U.S. solutions; and road safety in school zones solutions, including school crossing dual warning and enforcement system and stopping violation system for school buses. It also provides vehicle access control solutions, such as low emission zone, vehicle restricted urban zone, dedicated vehicle lane compliance, and selective short-cut enforcement; and uninsured vehicles and traffic policing. In addition, the company offers back-office software solutions comprising Flux, a sensor data collection and management platform; Puls, a data collection and analytics software; and Xilium, a violation processing software. Further, it provides TRaffic enforcement as a Service that manages the enforcement process. The company was formerly known as Sensys Traffic AB and changed its name to Sensys Gatso Group AB (publ) in August 2015. Sensys Gatso Group AB (publ) was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Jönköping, Sweden.
ceo: Mr. Lewis H. Miller B.A., J.D.
